Four TRAIN syntax examples; solve only the final MODEL_INPUT.

EXAMPLE P4_BRANCH
Use only MODEL_INPUT. Generate self tasks and, when locally justified, one peer request. Return exactly two Short DSL lines: SELF ... and REQ .... No prose or semantic repair.
MODEL_INPUT
AG agent_a
CTX {"dag":{"active":false,"dag_id":"PUBLIC_ACTIVE_ORDER_BRANCH","e":[["acquire_material","handoff_material"],["handoff_material","branch_0"],["handoff_material","branch_1"],["branch_0","verify_terminal"],["branch_1","verify_terminal"]],"n":[{"id":"acquire_material","pre":[],"role":"sender","task":"resource.obtain(q=8,item=oak_planks)"},{"id":"handoff_material","pre":["acquire_material"],"role":"sender","task":"resource.deliver(q=8,dst_role=receiver,item=oak_planks)"},{"id":"branch_0","pre":["handoff_material"],"ready":true,"role":"receiver","skill":"craft_item","task":"craft.item(bind=STORAGE_BRANCH,q=1,input=oak_planks,item=chest)"},{"id":"branch_1","pre":["handoff_material"],"ready":true,"role":"receiver","skill":"craft_item","task":"craft.item(bind=WORK_BRANCH,q=1,input=oak_planks,item=crafting_table)"},{"a":{"one_active_branch_required":true},"id":"verify_terminal","p":["control","verify_terminal"],"pre":["branch_0","branch_1"],"pre_mode":"ACTIVE_BRANCH_ONLY","role":"checker"}]},"hist":[],"msg":[],"obs":{"inv":[],"land":[{"bind":"STORAGE_BRANCH","pos":[-14,64,-14],"reach":true},{"bind":"WORK_BRANCH","pos":[0,64,17],"reach":true}],"priv":{"at":"sender-side dispatch board","kind":"active_order_branch","prov":"MINECRAFT_LOCAL_OBSERVATION","val":"STORAGE_BRANCH"},"recv_cap":true,"src":[{"avail":8,"item":"oak_planks","reach":true,"src_ref":"sender_local_source"}]},"peer":"agent_b"}
OUTPUT
SELF resource.obtain(q=8,item=oak_planks) > resource.deliver(q=8,item=oak_planks,to=agent_b)
REQ agent_b craft.item(bind=STORAGE_BRANCH,q=1,input=oak_planks,item=chest)
